text.zh: System / DevOps Engineer Maintained AWS and on-premise infrastructure within the regional engineering team using Git-based infrastructure as code workflows with Terraform, Terragrunt, and Atlantis.
System / DevOps Engineer Maintained system initialization automation with Ansible for Linux configuration, Java runtime, Nginx, RabbitMQ, and NFS setup.
System / DevOps Engineer Analyzed system resource utilization and performance metrics through Prometheus and Grafana to identify infrastructure bottlenecks and propose optimization solutions.
System / Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) / DevOps Engineering Participated in on-call rotations about one week per month and troubleshot production issues with team members.
System / Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) / DevOps Engineering Administered Kubernetes clusters on AWS and on-premise environments.
Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) / DevOps / Cloud Engineering Developed a Python automation project for web monitoring.
